up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1993 (DNA (cytosine-5)-methyltransferase 1) where the standard type is IC50. Filter for exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. Return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT
  a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  act.standard_type,
  act.pchembl_value
FROM target_dictionary td
JOIN assays a ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN activities act ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = act.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = act.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1993'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
LIMIT 1000
